evaluation_summary.strengths: The provided audio descriptions capture the dialogue accurately, which is crucial for accessibility. The descriptions of the visuals are generally acceptable, giving a basic understanding of what's happening on screen.
evaluation_summary.areas_for_improvement: Several critical accessibility issues need addressing.  Most notably, extensive on-screen text is completely missed in the audio description. This includes the title cards (Sony, Columbia Pictures, Marvel), the release date information, and the social media prompts at the end. Additionally, some visual descriptions are too brief and lack important details.  For example, simply stating "Hardy, kids flee" doesn't convey the full context or emotion of the scene. More descriptive language and detail would significantly enhance the experience for visually impaired viewers.  The descriptions also seem to miss strategically using inline descriptions, opting for extended descriptions where shorter inline descriptions would be more impactful and less disruptive to the flow of the trailer.

Reads Text-on-Screen.justification: The audio description fails to read any of the on-screen text, which is a major accessibility issue.  Key information like studio logos, release date, and calls to action are inaccessible to visually impaired users.

Inline Track Quality.justification: Some inline descriptions are present and adequately describe the visuals, but there are missed opportunities to use more inline descriptions in place of extended descriptions. The descriptions are also quite brief, missing opportunities to add more detail. More concise and descriptive inline descriptions would improve the overall quality.

Extended Track Quality.justification: The extended descriptions are present but often too short and lack detail. They do not fully capture the visual elements of each scene, leaving visually impaired viewers with an incomplete understanding.  Many important visual details are omitted.

strategic_AD_type_selection.justification: The AD primarily uses extended descriptions, even when inline descriptions would be more appropriate and less intrusive. This disrupts the flow of the trailer and could be improved by a better balance of inline and extended descriptions.

track_placement.justification: The audio description is generally well-timed and doesn't clash with dialogue or music. This ensures that the descriptions are clear and easy to understand without interrupting the original audio experience.
